model.name: Model for omeprazole metabolism in the liver

notes.body:
Model for omeprazole metabolism in the liver
S-omeprazole and R-omeprazole exchange fast between the plasma and the liver and are metabolized by CYP2C19 and CYP3A4, which act on the liver concentration (apparent Michaelis constants of the total concentration).
R-omeprazole: CYP2C19 to 5-hydroxyomeprazole, CYP3A4 to omeprazole sulfone.
S-omeprazole: CYP2C19 to 5-O-desmethylomeprazole (other metabolites) and a fraction to 5-hydroxyomeprazole, CYP3A4 to omeprazole sulfone.
5-hydroxyomeprazole is released into the plasma or oxidized in the liver to the other metabolites; omeprazole sulfone exchanges with the plasma and is metabolized by CYP2C19 and a CYP2C19 independent route to the other metabolites; the other metabolites are excreted into the bile.
CYP2C19 activity: genotype and interactions f_cyp2c19, mechanism-based inactivation by omeprazole cyp2c19_active; CYP3A4 activity: interactions f_cyp3a4.
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

parameter.name: activity of CYP2C19 (genotype, interactions)

body.p: Activity of CYP2C19 relative to the extensive metabolizer (*1/*1): the mean activity of the two alleles of the genotype (*1 1.0, *2 and *3 0 (no function), *17 1.5 (increased function)), i.e. extensive metabolizers 1.0, intermediate metabolizers 0.5 and poor metabolizers 0; multiplied by the factors of inhibiting drugs. Set by the experiments, never fitted.

parameter.name: activity of CYP3A4 (interactions)

body.p: Activity of CYP3A4 relative to the reference; inhibitors < 1, inducers

ol.li: Set by the experiments, never fitted.

parameter.name: rate of the omeprazole exchange between plasma and liver

body.p: Fast exchange (not fitted): the liver is in equilibrium with its plasma, the uptake does not limit the metabolism.

parameter.name: Km CYP2C19 omeprazole (apparent, total concentration)

body.p: Apparent Michaelis constant of CYP2C19 for S- and R-omeprazole of the total concentration in the liver: the Km of the high affinity 5-hydroxylation of liver microsomes (2.5-6 µM unbound, Andersson et al. 1993, Br J Clin Pharmacol 36:521) over the unbound fraction of omeprazole (0.05, 95 % bound), about 100 µM. Not fitted: the fits ran the Km to the upper bound of 50 µM with a lower cost (265 vs 270), it is not identifiable above it. The dose dependence of the bioavailability (Andersson1990a: 0.40 at 10 mg, 0.58 at 40 mg) comes from the mechanism-based inactivation of CYP2C19 during the first pass and the saturation of CYP2C19 at the portal concentrations of the larger doses.

parameter.name: Km CYP3A4 omeprazole (apparent, total concentration)

body.p: Michaelis constant of the CYP3A4 sulfoxidation, high (about 100 µM in vitro): linear at clinical doses. Not fitted.

parameter.name: fraction 5-hydroxyomeprazole of the CYP2C19 metabolism of S-omeprazole

body.p: CYP2C19 converts S-omeprazole mainly to 5-O-desmethylomeprazole; the 5-hydroxyomeprazole from S-omeprazole is 7 % of the one from R-omeprazole (HassanAlin2005 Tab4: AUC 0.11 vs 1.59 µmol*h/l). Not fitted.

parameter.name: fraction 5-hydroxyomeprazole of the CYP3A4 metabolism of R-omeprazole

body.p: CYP3A4 forms 5-hydroxyomeprazole besides the sulfone (the low affinity 5-hydroxylation of liver microsomes, Andersson et al. 1993, Br J Clin Pharmacol 36:521), the route of 5-hydroxyomeprazole in CYP2C19 poor metabolizers: their plasma and urine contain 5-hydroxyomeprazole (Sohn1992: Cmax 46 ng/ml, urine 5.6 % of the dose against 13.5 % of extensive metabolizers; Uno2007: PO AUC 364 vs 656 ng*h/ml). The 5-hydroxyomeprazole comes from R-omeprazole (HassanAlin2005 Tab4), the fraction is fitted.
The value of LI__f_rome_cyp3a4_omeoh is the result of the fit PK_20261020_090631__aa2cf, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: fraction of active CYP2C19

body.p: Fraction of CYP2C19 which is not inactivated by omeprazole, 1 without omeprazole.

parameter.name: degradation rate of CYP2C19
maximal inactivation rate of CYP2C19 by omeprazole

body.p: Maximal rate of the mechanism-based inactivation of CYP2C19 by S- and R-omeprazole (in vitro kinact of the order of 0.01-0.05 1/min [Ogilvie2011, Boulenc2012]); fitted on the repeated doses.
The value of LI__CYP2C19_kinact is the result of the fit PK_20261020_090631__aa2cf, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: concentration of half-maximal inactivation of CYP2C19

body.p: Apparent inactivation constant of the total liver concentration (in vitro KI of a few µM [Ogilvie2011, Boulenc2012]): the inactivation is saturated at the liver concentrations of a dose. Not fitted: not identifiable together with the inactivation rate; a KI of 0.1 mM (the in vitro KI over the unbound fraction) gave a higher cost (279.6 vs 265-270).

parameter.name: Vmax CYP2C19 S-omeprazole

body.p: The intrinsic clearance of S-omeprazole is about a third of the one of R-omeprazole [Abelo2000]: S AUC 2.5 fold R after a single oral dose (HassanAlin2005).
The value of LI__CYP2C19_Vmax_some is the result of the fit PK_20261020_090631__aa2cf, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: Vmax CYP3A4 S-omeprazole

body.p: The clearance of poor metabolizers of CYP2C19 (IV 50-150 ml/min [Regaardh1990, Uno2007]) is the one of CYP3A4; the sulfone comes from S-omeprazole.
The value of LI__CYP3A4_Vmax_some is the result of the fit PK_20261020_090631__aa2cf, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: rate of the 5-hydroxyomeprazole oxidation in the liver

body.p: The 5-hydroxyomeprazole of the liver is released into the plasma (OMEOHEX_k) or oxidized to the secondary metabolites (5-hydroxyomeprazole sulfone, carboxyomeprazole); the fraction released is OMEOHEX_k/(OMEOHEX_k + OMEOHM_k). In the plasma 5-hydroxyomeprazole is excreted by the kidneys.

parameter.name: rate of the metabolite exchange between plasma and liver

body.p: Fast exchange of omeprazole sulfone and the other metabolites between the liver and its plasma (not fitted).

parameter.name: rate of the CYP2C19 metabolism of omeprazole sulfone

body.p: Omeprazole sulfone is hydroxylated by CYP2C19 to 5-hydroxyomeprazole sulfone: half-life 2-2.6 hr in extensive metabolizers [Andersson1990a, HassanAlin2000, Palovaara2003].
The value of LI__OMESUL2C19_k is the result of the fit PK_20261020_090631__aa2cf, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: rate of the CYP2C19 independent metabolism of omeprazole sulfone

body.p: The sulfone of poor metabolizers has a half-life of 7.5-11 hr (Regaardh1990 Tab3): a slow CYP2C19 independent clearance.
The value of LI__OMESULM_k is the result of the fit PK_20261020_090631__aa2cf, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

body.p: Feces 17-19 % of the radioactivity of an IV or oral dose [Regaardh1986, Regaardh1990], no unchanged omeprazole.
